Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands over his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. Jack refuses to take his medication, his voice laced with defiance 🗣️.

DR. SMITH:
(firmly)
Jack, you need to take your pills. They're the only thing that can keep you stable 📊.

JACK:
(outraged)
I don't need your pills! I'm fine! 🙅‍♂️

DR. SMITH:
(exasperated)
Fine? You're not fine, Jack. You're a danger to yourself and others 🚨.

JACK:
(smirking)
You're just trying to control me, Doc. But I'm not going to take it 🚫.

DR. SMITH:
(frustrated)
Fine. If you won't take them, I'll take them for you 🤯.

Dr. Smith reaches for the pills, but Jack intercepts his hand 🚫. The two engage in a struggle, with Dr. Smith trying to force the pills down Jack's throat 💉.

JACK:
(triumphant)
Ha! You can't make me take them! I'm free! 🎉

Dr. Smith's eyes widen in shock as Jack disappears into thin air 🔮. The doctor looks around, confused, and that's when he realizes the truth: he's the one who's been imagining the whole thing 🤯.

DR. SMITH:
(whispering)
Oh no... I'm the one who's been sick all along 🤕.

The camera zooms out, revealing Dr. Smith sitting alone in his office, surrounded by empty pill bottles and scattered papers 📝. The words "The Doctor is Mad" appear on the screen, as the sound of maniacal laughter echoes through the asylum 🎃.

FADE TO BLACK 🎬
